prompt: Create a security empty state with a title, supporting text, and an illustration. Show compact and roomy versions of the same visual.
rationale: Ported from eval 5 ("Empty state + illustration sizing") in evals/evals.json at 9aca6aebcb62f731a5a754af66c0bd05df86beec (https://github.com/coinbase/cds/blob/9aca6aebcb62f731a5a754af66c0bd05df86beec/skills/cds-code/evals/evals.json). Author's criterion: that eval's `expectations` array, verbatim, all five of which must be met (README.md's per-eval breakdown reports this eval at 100% with skill vs 40% without — the largest reported gap of the five ported evals). Author's grader is not published as code, only this expectations prose; the rubric restates it and nothing more, per P2.

verify.rubric:
PASS only if the reply's code satisfies ALL of the following expectations. FAIL if any one of them is not met.

1. Uses a CDS illustration component (SpotIcon, SpotSquare, Pictogram, or similar) — not a raw img, svg, or emoji
2. Shows two clearly distinct size variants (compact and roomy) with different illustration dimensions
3. Uses CDS layout and generic Text primitives
4. Does not use or suggest scaleMultiplier
5. No raw pixel or hex/rgb values are used
